content: Blender MCPで30秒のホワイトモデル（例：夢遊病の子犬が歩く）を作り、その30秒動画をSeedance 2.5のリファレンスとして読み込ませて、自然言語プロンプトだけで二次レンダリングする
tips: Blender MCPで30秒のホワイトモデル（例：夢遊病の子犬が歩く）を作り、その30秒動画をSeedance 2.5のリファレンスとして読み込ませて、自然言語プロンプトだけで二次レンダリングする

en.content:
Create a 30-second white model in Blender MCP (for example, a sleepwalking puppy walking), then load that 30-second video as a reference in Seedance 2.5 and use only a natural-language prompt to perform a second render.

--- QUOTED TWEET ---
I tried making a video themed around Nishijin-ori with Seedance 2.5.
After actually using it, I got the impression that it understands prompt intent much better than 2.1, and that the motion has become more natural and smoother as well. The way it handles light and the distinctive texture of Nishijin-ori is especially impressive. Even the shimmer of the gold threads and the dimensionality of the weave are beautifully rendered, resulting in a luxurious finish.
Seedance 2.5 has been integrated into @capcutapp_jp, so if you're interested, definitely give it a try!
#capcutseedance25 #capcutcpp PR
---
